test_title: PYST 67: SSC CPO - General Knowledge and General Awareness (Held On 09 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: gk
question:
The "Indian Councils Act of 1892" represented a limited expansion of Indian participation in the legislative councils.

What was a notable feature of this Act regarding the selection of Indian members?

options.text: It introduced universal adult suffrage for the election of Indian members.
It allowed for the direct election of a majority of Indian members to the central legislative council.
It permitted the nomination of some Indian members by the Governor-General and provided for indirect election through electoral colleges.
It mandated equal representation for all religious communities in the legislative councils.

solution:
The correct answer is __**It permitted the nomination of some Indian members by the Governor-General and provided for indirect election through electoral colleges.**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Indian Councils Act of 1892 aimed to expand the role of Indians in legislative processes, though in a limited manner.
 
• Under this Act, the Governor-General and provincial governors were permitted to nominate Indian members to the legislative councils.
 
• It introduced the concept of indirect election through electoral colleges, where members were selected by specific groups such as municipalities, district boards, universities, and chambers of commerce.
 
• The nominated and indirectly elected Indian members were given the right to discuss the budget, though not to vote on it.
 
• The Act served as a precursor to later reforms like the Morley-Minto Reforms of 1909, which further expanded Indian representation in councils.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: It introduced universal adult suffrage for the election of Indian members**

 
 
• This is incorrect as universal adult suffrage was not introduced until much later in India’s constitutional history, specifically after the enactment of the Constitution of India in 1950.
 
• The 1892 Act only allowed for indirect elections, not direct elections or universal suffrage.
 
 
 
• **Option 2: It allowed for the direct election of a majority of Indian members to the central legislative council**
 
 
• This is incorrect as the Act did not provide for direct elections. Instead, it introduced indirect elections through electoral colleges.
 
• Direct elections were introduced much later during the Government of India Act of 1919 and expanded further in 1935.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: It mandated equal representation for all religious communities in the legislative councils**
 
 
• This is incorrect as the Indian Councils Act of 1892 did not mandate equal representation for all religious communities.
 
• Such provisions were introduced later under the Morley-Minto Reforms of 1909, which introduced separate electorates for Muslims.
